entry = rlm.harness.create_memory(title='ARC task-7064b436: connect endpoints of aligned line fragments', content='For task-7064b436, output adds color 2 in gaps connecting aligned foreground line endpoints, but not every row/column gap. Infer/select the outer/terminal endpoints of horizontal or vertical line fragments; fill a gap only when it connects relevant segment endpoints. In demo 7, row 1 had two markers already connected via the top row and the intervening row gap was NOT filled; in demo 8 and demo 3, internal horizontal pairs were left unfilled while top/bottom extremity connections were filled. On the test 8x9, do NOT fill internal horizontal gaps in rows 1,3,4; fill vertical c2 between r1-r3, vertical c7 between r0-r3, and horizontal row5 between c2-c7. Correct output adds 2 at (r2,c2), (r1,c7), (r2,c7), and (r5,c3..c6), preserving original marker/background cells. Avoid naive rule “fill every row/column gap between matching pixels”: that produced incorrect outputs. Also avoid assuming mere connected-component separation suffices; that was incorrect. Useful pattern: connect terminal ends of aligned fragments / outer line boundaries, not arbitrary interior chords.', path='arc-patterns', global_=True)
entry
